messages.subject: Re: error in adding matrix
parts:
This question may be more appropriate for the general R email list, R-
help;
see http://www.r-project.org/mail.html

The issue is, I think, that many of these columns are factors rather
than numeric. Try the following

for(i in 1:ncol(RED))
RED[,i] <- as.numeric(as.character(RED[,i]))

karl
